summary.grade_reason: High-confidence tamper drift: a custom-node file changed without its git commit changing (DRIFT-001), and a known-malicious node appeared (DRIFT-002 -> PATCH-007).

findings.title: Custom node file changed but git commit unchanged
findings.evidence: tree_hash changed sha256:bb22..->sha256:dd44..; recorded commit 3a1f9c2 unchanged. A matching commit should produce a matching hash.
findings.description: The node's source changed on disk while its pinned git commit stayed the same. Deterministic content should hash identically for the same commit, so this is a tamper indicator, not a normal update.
findings.impact: Code running inside ComfyUI was modified out-of-band, a common post-compromise persistence pattern.

remediation.summary: Quarantine the node, compare against the upstream commit, and treat the host as possibly compromised.
remediation.action: Move custom_nodes/handy-tools aside; diff util.py against the pinned commit; investigate how it changed.
remediation.rollback: Restore from the clean baseline snapshot via comfyharden restore.

findings.title: New custom node appeared since baseline
findings.evidence: Node absent in baseline, present now. Cross-referenced NODE and PATCH checks: matches the Upscaler-4K / Akira IOC set (PATCH-007).
findings.description: A custom node was installed after the baseline and matches a known info-stealer campaign. New nodes are routed through the static-analysis and known-malicious checks automatically.
findings.impact: Credential and wallet theft, persistence, and exfiltration when the node loads.

remediation.summary: Quarantine the node; investigate persistence; treat the host as compromised.
remediation.rollback: Restore from the clean baseline snapshot.

findings.title: ComfyUI-Manager security downgraded
findings.description: The Manager security level was lowered and runtime pip install was enabled since the baseline, widening the install/RCE surface.
findings.impact: High-risk install operations (arbitrary pip and git-URL installs) are now permitted.

remediation.summary: Restore security_level to strong and disable the install flags.

findings.title: Exposure regression: bind widened to all interfaces
findings.description: The instance was reachable only on loopback in the baseline and now binds all interfaces.
findings.impact: Every unauthenticated endpoint is now exposed to the network.

remediation.summary: Rebind to loopback and reach the instance through the authenticating proxy.

findings.title: Core ComfyUI commit changed
findings.evidence: core commit 7c0d1e2 -> 9f1c2ab since baseline; still version 0.3.62.
findings.description: The core checkout moved. Cross-referenced with PATCH checks: the new commit is not in a known-vulnerable range, so this is recorded as a stability change to confirm, not a security regression.
findings.impact: Possible workflow behavior change after a core update.

remediation.summary: Confirm the core update was intended and smoke-test workflows.
remediation.action: Verify the commit change was expected.
remediation.rollback: Restore the baseline core commit via comfyharden restore if a workflow regressed.
